pay_detail: Flat-rate stipend, higher in the second year. The amount is not stated. Housing and meals are provided in dorms at the fair.
duration: About 2 weeks (arrive the Monday before the Wednesday opening)
notes: The page does not say whether a work permit is needed for minors. Ask the coordinators.
name: Ohio State Fair Junior Fair Board
org: Ohio Expo Center, Ohio State Fair
what_you_do: Serve as a welcoming host for about two weeks at the Ohio State Fair: welcome guests at fair events, and meet people for networking. Housing and meals are provided.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 20 who are now in a youth or career tech group. Examples are 4-H, FFA, DECA, Girl Scouts, Scouting America and Key Club. You need strong leadership and a record of being involved. Members serve one two-year term.
deadline_text: The page says the online application portal opens January 1 and the application is due March 1. Notices come early to mid March, interviews mid to late March, selection early April. No year is shown, so confirm the 2027 dates in January.
how_to_apply: Send the official Junior Fair Board application in the online portal on the Ohio State Fair page. Do it between January 1 and March 1. Interviews come next. Send questions to the co-coordinators listed on the page.
